Team dossier Operation Hot Air

Pyro Posse

Fire-themed. Balloon-powered. Counting is hard.

Team color
Orange
Threat level
Extra crispy, extra confident
Catnip & Hairball
8 hairballs · 7 catnip

Known for

  • A fire theme delivered, in PNN-004, with balloons.
  • Three pranks in one night, plus a fourth they forgot to mention (PNN-005).
  • Posting the photos before the victims got home, then deleting them.
  • Telling the game group 'It's like we're the only ones playing.'

The file

The Pyro Posse arrived with the boldest brand in the game: fire, a promise to 'bring them to ash,' and poster art that looks like it has its own budget. Then they went to the party store. In PNN-004 the flames were balloons and tissue paper. PNN admires the confidence. PNN also admires the receipt.

By PNN-005 the Posse had escalated to actual laundry, actual smoke, and a poem narrated by underwear. They pranked the Tightie Whities, the Silver Bullets, and the Black Webb Bandits in a single night. That is a lot of work. It is also a lot of photos, which the Posse posted to the game group before the victims got home, spoiling the surprise for exactly the people it was built for.

Sometimes I am fast…. Usually when I shouldn’t be.

— a Pyro Posse member, on the deleted photos

The Posse also declared, 'It’s like we’re the only ones playing,' which is what a runner says after the first mile of a marathon. They then forgot to mention one of their own pranks for a day. They have pranked four teams and can count three.

For the record, PNN reminds the Posse that actual fire is not part of the game. A paper flame on a stick delivers all the drama and none of the paperwork. The Posse owns a great many paper flames. This is fine.

Strengths

  • Effort. Real, enormous, visible effort.
  • Poster art that could frighten a lesser team.
  • A work rate that makes everyone else look like tourists.

Weaknesses

  • Secrets.
  • Counting.
  • The delete button, which they find too late.

Clueso's advice

Wait until the victim has seen the prank before you post it. It will be the best surprise you ever delivered.

— Inspector Clueso, PNN
